title: Integration-Led Growth (Ecosystem GTM)
tagline: Grow through the tools customers already use: a step-by-step OAuth 2.0 + PKCE flow checker, Zapier / Make-style template recommendations from connected apps, and partner-sourced vs influenced revenue with integration win-rate lift.
why: Customers who connect three integrations churn less and buy more, and partners bring deals a sales team cannot reach alone. But marketplace listings stall on OAuth bugs, customers never find the template that fits their stack, and partner revenue is argued about in every QBR. This repo makes the flow checkable, the next template obvious, and partner credit countable.
covers: OAuth 2.0 authorization code + PKCE (RFC 7636 S256), checked step by step: client id, exact redirect URI, https, scopes, state length and match, verifier format, challenge, code reuse and age
SHA-256 + base64url verified against the RFC 7636 appendix B test vector
Token refresh plan: refresh before expiry with a skew
Template recommendations: ready now vs one connection away, goal-tag match, installs; the one app that unlocks the most templates
Ecosystem revenue: partner-sourced vs influenced-only, per-partner co-sell table, win rate with vs without an integration in use
gaps: Checks a recorded flow; it is not an authorization server and issues no tokens
No Zapier / Make API: the catalog is synthetic
Integration lift is a correlation on closed deals, not a causal estimate
